title: Winnie | Botanical Relaxed Trousers in Soft Tones
bodyHtml:
Light, lovely and built for comfort, these relaxed trousers feature a soft botanical print that brings an effortless, natural ease to your everyday. The gentle blue and beige pattern on a pale base creates a luminous, calming look that works beautifully whether you're heading to the shops or settling in at home. With a generous fit and all-day comfort, they move with you through warm days and cooler evenings without any fuss.

Why you'll love it

  • Generous, skimming fit that lets you move freely without clinging
  • Soft botanical print in muted blues and beiges — pretty without being precious
  • Practical side pockets — because who doesn't love real pockets?
  • Relaxed styling that feels put-together without any effort
  • Works beautifully with lightweight tops, simple tees or sandals
  • Versatile enough for a coffee run, a holiday, or a quiet weekend at home
  • Effortlessly hard to fault — just throw them on and feel yourself

Over 50,000 women have already chosen us, with an average rating of 4.8 out of 5. Your happiness and your trust mean everything to us.
